steps.name: Ash
steps.text: You can do it! Lord!

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Hnng... Grrrgh! Gah...!

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Almost! Just a little more!

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: And... Hah!

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: It's up!

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Well done!

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Yes... It's very impressive you can pull back this crossbow with your bare hands.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: What a design. You couldn't tell by looking at it that this crossbow has such tensile strength.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: It's a pretty ordinary crossbow. Most Sarkaz can lock it barehanded.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: A heavy crossbow with this kind of power... at least than one hundred meters, it won't be that different from a gun. It's just too much work.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: ...And I already learned the hard way that bit about our physical differences.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: That zappy girl over there might be no weaker than me.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Are you talking about Liskarm? She's a Vouivre. They're a strong race, for sure.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Right......

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Why the sudden interest in these weapons?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: We're expecting a lot of fights soon, so it's time to think about what to do when we run out of ammo.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Without bullets, my gun might as well be a paperweight.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: I don't think we can take them hand-to-hand when it comes to that. And our training and experience won't be enough either.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: How much do we have left?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Not much over here. Not even four hundred rounds.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Let me show you something.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Is this a... bullet?

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: It's a bullet that Rhodes Islander named Liskarm uses. They call it an 'etched bullet,' and it's apparently an extremely expensive commodity.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Did you take it apart yet?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: What's it made of? What's the propellant?

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: This chunk of crystal.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Looks like an energy source. Is that a propellant or a warhead?

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: A Laterano gunsmith once told me that every single etched bullet contains a miniature casting unit that matches up with the structure of a Laterano gun.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: That means it's not only the gun, but every etched bullet, is basically a caster's staff. That's why they're so expensive, and why they need such complicated Arts that only Sankta can make much use of them.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Other peoples go with easier ranged weapons.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: So Laterano is the name of the country, Sankta is the name of the race. Laterano people are not necessarily Sankta... Got it.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: But that's real bad news about the bullets.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Do we have any gun here that doesn't require those 'Originium Arts' to work?

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: I've never heard about those firearms that don't need Originium Arts.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: (Sigh)...

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: One step at a time. At least everybody can use explosives.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Where did Kötz go with them?

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: They're in the basement. Still trying to fix the thing that looks like a radio transmitter.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: We can't power the comm casting unit.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: It's a power problem?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Maybe... I'll have to see.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Okay, you all take a step back. The valedictorian is about to do her stuff.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: ...Charging...

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Oh! Ooh! Oooh!

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Was that Arts? It was pretty cool.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: It definitely... leaves an impression.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Is it working?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: It's on!

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Great work. That's my walking power supply.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Don't you have anything better to do than annoy me?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: No good. It's still not connecting.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: The crystal electronics unit may be too damaged. Or there may be some damage somewhere else in the circuit we can't see with the naked eye.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: We don't have any equipment for repairing Originium circuits here, so we can't troubleshoot.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: *Sigh*, sounds pretty hopeless.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Can ordinary people do these Originium Arts too?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Theoretically... almost anyone can learn to do Arts at some level, with enough training.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: It's just that studying Arts takes time and effort, and that gets tied up pretty close with talent.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Lots of people master only the most basic Arts, even after pushing themselves a lot harder than others.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: I'm a dumb old man, and I've never learned any Originium Arts.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: What are you thinking?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Nothing... Just brainstorming about our situation here... some wild, impractical ideas.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Oh, right, Mr. Kötz.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Take a look at this shield here.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: What's... what's that on the shield?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I installed a high-powered spotlight and a universal Originium circuit based on the original design and function of your shield. It should work just like you're used to.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Thanks a bundle!

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: ...Oh... But I can't use 'Originium Arts'.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Strictly speaking, a universal Originium circuit is a piece of modern technology that lets people who don't know how to use Arts use it anyway. It is loaded with a few simple Originium Arts.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Of course, the power supply and equipment maintenance still need to be carried out by a trained caster.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: All right, let's see. It's still pretty heavy.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: ...Turn it on... Hit the switch...

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: All good. I'll give it a try.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Wow! It really works!

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: But it'll take some getting used to.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: I haven't done a shield charge in six months. I've almost forgotten how to use the thing.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: How are things looking outside?

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: The last attack was also the last enemy movement. We haven't seen any probing strikes since. I don't think that's a good sign.

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: Especially considering what a well-organized bunch of punks they are, I've got a bad feeling about this.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: The calm before the storm.

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: Sure enough.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Where's the doctor?

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: Resting. He hasn't slept in days.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Give the kid a break.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: He shouldn't have to deal with all this at his age.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: And we've got another problem on our hands. We're running out of food.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Right. Mr. Occphen told us.

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: What are you thinking?

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: I'm thinking whether or not we should take a trip back to the Infected quarter.

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: I get you.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Oh? You have a plan?

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: We left in a hurry. A lot of the sick people didn't have time to bring their food from home.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: True. We have enough hands here. We could send some people out to get supplies.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Then let's save our talk here. We should be able to get there before the night falls.
